summary: All JSON data files are valid and structurally sound. No corruption detected. Minor schema inconsistencies found related to frontend state persistence.

bugs.issue: All note records have empty title field
bugs.description: Every note object has title: '' (empty string). The data model supports titles but all entries are blank. Not a data corruption issue, but indicates feature is unused or incomplete.
bugs.impact: UI shows empty title field for all notes. Title editing feature (if implemented) is not being used.

bugs.issue: All stopwatch records have started_at: null despite is_running: false
bugs.description: Both stopwatches have is_running=false and started_at=null, which is consistent. However, if a stopwatch were running (is_running=true), the started_at must be a valid timestamp for frontend time calculation (per backend-dev message: 'elapsed_ms + (Date.now() - Date.parse(started_at))'). Currently no way to verify this constraint.
bugs.impact: Low - only matters if stopwatches transition to running state. Currently safe.

inconsistencies.type: Schema mismatch: stopwatches backend vs frontend
inconsistencies.issue: Backend API spec includes fields not in persisted data

details.backend_endpoints: Backend deliverable lists POST /api/stopwatches/{id}/lap endpoint returning lap times
details.spec_statement: Response format: {id, label, elapsed_ms, is_running, started_at, created_at}
details.problem: Lap time tracking API endpoint exists in spec, but storage schema doesn't support it

inconsistencies.recommendation: Either remove /lap endpoint from backend or add lap_times array to stopwatch schema

inconsistencies.issue: Frontend doesn't use stopwatch backend API
inconsistencies.details: Frontend deliverable states 'State persists in localStorage (not using backend API)'. Backend created stopwatches.json but frontend doesn't consume it.
inconsistencies.implication: stopwatches.json becomes stale. Frontend changes won't sync to backend.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Decide: (1) Use backend API + stopwatches.json for sync, OR (2) remove backend persistence entirely

inconsistencies.description: Task objects have: id, text, priority, completed, description. No created_at or updated_at timestamps.
inconsistencies.note_api_has_timestamps: Notes API enforces created_at and updated_at (see main.py line 975-976). Tasks don't follow same pattern.
inconsistencies.impact: Can't track task creation/modification times. Audit trails impossible.

orphaned_data.note: No orphaned data detected. All IDs follow consistent 8-character hex format (UUID[:8]). No cross-references found in any file, so no orphan possibilities.

suggestions.detail: Frontend uses localStorage, backend has stopwatches.json. Choose one: (A) Remove backend persistence and API endpoints for stopwatches, OR (B) Refactor frontend to sync with backend API instead of localStorage. Current split leads to data divergence.
Add created_at and updated_at to task schema (follow notes.json pattern). Will enable audit trails and modification tracking.
Backend spec mentions POST /api/stopwatches/{id}/lap endpoint but stopwatches.json has no lap_times field. Either implement full lap time storage or remove the endpoint from backend.
All notes have empty title field. Either start using titles or remove the field from schema to simplify.

suggestions.action: Document stopwatch API lap endpoint behavior
suggestions.detail: Backend deliverable claims lap endpoint exists, but unclear if it persists, returns calculated value, or both. Add docstring to clarify.
